args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212,
but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly test
tests/test_money.py to fail. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP` while the test `tests/test_money.py` (and the docstring) expect banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: import and apply `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`, matching the FIN-212 rounding policy.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (including `tests/test_money.py`).
